13 CYTOTOXICITY SCORING 
Criteria for evaluating cytotoxicity will include morphologic changes in cells, such as 
granulation, crenation, or rounding, and loss of viable cells from the monolayer by 
lysis or detachment.   The validity of the test requires that neg ative control cultures 
maintain a healthy normal appearance throughout the duration of the test.  Degrees of 
toxicity are scored as follows. 
Grade Reactivity Conditions of all Cultures 
0 None Discrete intracytoplasmic granules; no cell lysis, no reduction of cell growth. 
1 Slight 
Not more than 20% of the cells are round, loosely attached, and without 
intracytoplasmic granules, or show changes in morphology; occasional 
lysed cells are present; only slight growth inhibition observable. 
2 Mild 
Not more than 50% of the cells are round, devoid of intracytoplasmic 
granules, no extensive cell lysis; not more than 50% growth inhibition 
observable. 
3 Moderate 
Not more than 70% of the cell layers contain rounded cells or are lysed; 
cells layers not completely destroyed, but more than 50% growth 
inhibition observable. 
4 Severe Nearly complete or complete destruction of the cell layers. 
14 RESULTS ANALYSIS 
14.1 Assay Validity 
Final evaluation of the validity of the assay and test article results will be based 
upon the criteria listed below and scientific judgment. 
 The vehicle controls must retain a healthy normal appearance throughout the 
duration of the test and must be scored “0”. 
 The negative controls must retain a healthy normal appearance throughout 
the duration of the test and must be scored “0”. 
 Positive control must display a moderate to severe cytotoxic reaction, 
displaying a score of ‘3’ or ‘4’ by final reading of the test. 
14.2 Test Article Evaluation Criteria 
Negative Response: 
Sample cultures scores of “0”, “1”, or, “2” on all scoring points, the sampl e is 
considered to be “NONTOXIC” and will be reported as “NON- CYTOTOXIC”. 
Positive Response: 
Sample cultures scores “3” on some or all scoring points, the sample is considered 
to be “MODERATELY TOXIC” and will be reported as “CYTOTOXIC”. 
Sample cultures d isplaying scores “4” at any of the scoring points, the sample is 
considered “TOXIC” and will be reported as “CYTOTOXIC”.

Durability verification protocol
Product name: Anti Snoring Mouthpiece
Document No: SYYFYZ-ASM-DV01

Purpose
This durability verification is to confirm that the device still can work well after undergoing molding, normal use, and cleaning processes at least 365 times/cycles.
Scope of test
This test is applicable to the Anti Snoring Mouthpiece of RAM.SHAW PTE.LTD.
Device description
Product name: Anti Snoring Mouthpiece
Model: L08-BP, L08-PT, L08-BT, L08-TP, L08-TB, L08-PB
Size: Large (L) and Standard (S)
Intended use: Advance the user’s lower jaw and maintain this position during use, opening the airway to reduce snoring during sleep.
Usage period: 6-12 months
Test sample and sample size
Test sample: L08-BP with Large size.
For the difference between different models, they are only different in the color of tray. 
For the difference between different size, they are only different in the dimension of tray. 
Given that this test is mainly related to the characteristic of material - EVA, and different models or different sizes use the same EVA, thus the L08-BP with large size can represent all the models and size.  
Type of test: Comparison test.
Sample size: 2 L08-BP are selected in this test, which make 2 Tray A0, 2 Tray A2, 2 Tray A4, 2 Tray B0, 2 Tray B1, 2 Tray B2. 
1 Tray A0, 1 Tray A2, 1 Tray A4, 1 Tray B0, 1 Tray B1, 1 Tray B2, a total of 6 samples are selected as positive group, and another 6 samples (1 Tray A0, 1 Tray A2, 1 Tray A4, 1 Tray B0, 1 Tray B1, 1 Tray B2) are selected as blank group.
Acceptance criteria
Pre-test criteria:
Odour: No pungent odor, no odor.
Post-test criteria:
Odour: No pungent odor, no odor.
Shape of tray: Put the device on the denture, device can fit well with the denture. (Note: Blank group is not require to evaluate shape of tray)
During the testing, other abnormal condition should also be documented.
Procedure
Prepare 2 L08-BP of one batch, and separate them into two groups: test group and blank group.
Verify if all these samples meet the pre-test acceptance criteria and record the results.
For blank group, they will be put into package box again until the end of durability test. For test group, they will undergo one molding procedure and 365 times simulated use, and 365 times cleaning processes.
According to the instruction of user manual, prepare a pot with boiling water. And then use a tweezer to submerge the samples in hot water above 80℃ for 1.5 to 2 minutes.
Use tweezer to remove the samples from the hot water. Use denture for molding the specific shape. Then rinse with water until it is cooled.
Simulated occlusion. Wipe the dental model with the artificial saliva. Fix the  device on the dental model and simulate the position and direction of the teeth during the occlusion process. Make sure that the teeth are completely closed. Repeat the occlusions process for 10 times.
Squeeze dish soap on the device and then use soft brush to lightly brush the device for 15 seconds to remove dirt.
